title: Receipts logged after a check: yesterday's and the day before's stay inside the check, because their dates ended before it (AN4, H1)
story: Set up Thu 10 Dec 2026 in Tokyo, pay day: the bank holds 400,000, of which Free to spend 60,000 (typed). Pay of 300,000 on the 10th (moved earlier). Mon 14 Dec: Jun checks in at 10:00: 380,000. At 12:00 the same day he finds two receipts in his wallet and logs both from the bank on Free to spend: 4,000 for Sun 13 Dec and 6,000 for Sat 12 Dec. A check holds an event when the end of the event's date, in its writer's offset (taken from its `told`), is at or before the check's moment; otherwise `told` decides (H1) [AN4]. Sunday ended at 00:00 on Monday in Tokyo (his phone's offset, +09:00, from each receipt's `told`), before the 10:00 check, so both receipts were already spent when the bank showed 380,000: both are inside the check, whatever their `told`, and shrink its filler. Before AN4 (under AM3) the receipt from Sunday was judged by `told` and taken off the bank figure a second time. One phone, one zone. Every amount is made up.

events.note: Jun: a receipt from Saturday, logged after the check; Saturday ended before the check, so inside it [AN4]
Jun: a receipt from Sunday, logged after the check; Sunday ended at 00:00 Monday Tokyo time, before the 10:00 check, so inside it [AN4]

asks.question: bank_today
asks.why: 380,000 (check, Mon 14 Dec 10:00; both receipts are inside it: Sat 12 Dec and Sun 13 Dec each ended, in Tokyo, before 10:00 on Mon 14 Dec [AN4]) = 380,000
asks.note: The bank figure already has yesterday's lunch off: taking the 4,000 off again would show 376,000 while the bank app shows 380,000, and the next check would find an unexplained 4,000 gain (confirm_review_7, AM3 soundness). Under AM3: 376,000.

asks.question: not_explained
asks.why: 400,000 (opening, Thu 10 Dec; the pay of 10 Dec is in it) - 6,000 (the receipt dated 12 Dec, inside the check) - 4,000 (the receipt dated 13 Dec, inside the check) - 380,000 (check, Mon 14 Dec) = 10,000
asks.note: Both receipts explain part of the gap the check found [AN4]. Under AM3: 14,000.

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 60,000 (Free to spend at the opening) - 10,000 (the filler of Mon 14 Dec) - 6,000 (12 Dec) - 4,000 (13 Dec) = 40,000
asks.note: Each receipt is counted once, inside the check, and the filler is what is left unexplained. Under AM3: 36,000, 4,000 too low (counted twice).
